name: Autoresearch-Style Compiler Bootstrap Pipeline
description: Multi-session research project: build a self-iterating AI pipeline that reads an unfamiliar system, segments it structurally, emits candidate compilers (extractors + graph builders + query CLIs), measures them against a fixed ground-truth harness, and iterates until query-pass-rate plateaus. Modeled on Karpathy's autoresearch three-file separation (fixed harness / mutable target / slow-evolving protocol). Implementation root: `comp/`. Transferable artifact: `comp/program.md` accrues into the generalized 'how to build a compiler for an arbitrary system' skill across target runs.
inspiration: C:/Users/AndrewBerman/Downloads/autoresearch-master.zip (Karpathy). Three-file pattern: prepare.py (fixed harness), train.py (agent mutates), program.md (human-tuned protocol).
phase: Phase 0 — registration + scaffolding. Next: pick first benchmark target (candidates: httpx, a small internal service, this repo), author ground-truth harness (~50 queries) by hand, run first iteration.
blocking: First benchmark target selection + ~4-6 hrs of human harness authoring before any agent loop can run honestly.
